# Scaled bounded carrier callback

Original Java signatures relate the same Object/nominal-bound method formals
across a scope carrier, an animation carrier, a frame carrier and the callback's
consumer input. The private static target retains its complete signature; a
public erased access method supplies the original lexical invocation.

Frozen direct, precompiled, reflection and method-handle callers compare the
original and recovered D8 classes. The observer checks long extrema, float raw
bits including NaN payload and signed zero, all reference identities, nulls,
ordered provider reads and frame/callback writes, original closed callback
casts and partial state after failures. Four wrong programs change the scope,
time, scale or effect order and must fail the independent observer.

The SDK variant borrows only authored interface/value declarations. No original
instruction or classfile metadata is rewritten.
